description: Land Title Settlement Department - Petiyagoda, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710012
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) in various locations. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land adjudication and title determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
